mentions.name: Neovim competitive programming extension
mentions.description: This Neovim extension streamlines competitive programming by letting users jump straight into a problem with commands like ":CSES 1068" or ":CF 1802B", then solve it and verify the solution against sample test cases locally.
mentions.problem: Wanted a faster workflow for solving competitive programming problems and verifying solutions against sample cases locally.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a neovim extension to help with my competitive programming hobby, so that I can just go ":CSES 1068"/":CF 1802B" and solve the problem/verify against sample cases locally.
